notes.title: Patch 1 (1.0.1)
notes.content:
We love the community that Chenso Club has attracted and we are happy to see that a majority of you are having fun with the game!

[b]Here are some fixes for this build:[/b]

- We've done updates to how controllers are set up with Steam's backend. This should fix most controller issues. Please let us know if you experience any remaining issues.
- Steam remote play should now properly detect player input
- Powerups "Revive" and "Time Stop" are now able to spawn in the game.
- Playtime timer available in the credits after you beat the game
- Guaranteed shop on first cleared room if void portal is unlocked
- Boomering cooldown decreased from 5 -> 2
- Added Speedrunners and ESA people to Credits
- Here comes plum instrumental version available in the credits
- Lightfoot and Laser gun are now unlocked by default.
- Void pull and Shockwave are now unlockables in ChensoHQ
- Checkpoints in void will no longer make you respawn in walls.
- Hoarded archievement is now fixed
- You are now able to skip the credits
- Increased Drone teleport distance
- Resetting save does not reset achievements.
- Added semi-solid platforms to the void to help with traversal
- SFX adjustments and volume tweaking
- Invulnerability powerup does not affect after-dash invulnerability timer anymore
- Lingering hitboxes on Green Walker and Jester fixed.
- Blackhole powerup now activates on player position instead of infront of player
- Fixed duplicate MR.Time.
- Localizations issues fixed.
- Fixed superfan grabbing giving permanent slowdown.
- Fixed some sprites that were not rendering correctly from doing Darkness quests.
- Fixed decorations floating in mid-air.
- Minor level fixes
- Burning City image in Stage Select is updated

We will continue to listen to your feedback. 
What matters the most to us is the experience we bring to you

Thanks you!

notes.title: Regarding Revoked Keys
notes.content:
Hello, Koni here!

We've heard your concerns regarding the revoked keys and I decided I'll shed light on why.

Due to multiple security issues, we've had to revoke keys before launch. It was a serious problem and sadly we had to revoke keys to make sure everything was safe and sound.

The keys we've sent out was also meant as a Closed Beta and not a full game, meaning it wasn't a key that would last forever. As for the Demo on the store page - we might add a new one for launch.

[b]If you're a content creator or a press individual that we've worked with previously, you'll be sent a new key before the embargo date.[/b]

We have the contact information of people we've worked with. But if you still have worries about the matter, please send us an email at [b]info@pixadome.com[/b].

I'm sorry we bummed you out about this. It's actually quite humbling to know that some of you were still playing the old beta to this date and for that I'm very thankful!

I hope you'll enjoy the full game!

- Koni, Chenso Club Director

notes.title: Chenso Club Devlog # 17- New Year!
notes.content:
New year, new me! 

Well not exactly, we’re still working on the same game, of course! But we’ve added a ton of new stuff since the last time we made an update and we will share some of it today.

[b]Cinematics![/b]
We’re hard at work on the cinematics, and it’s taking a while to complete. We did the math and we have 281 panels in the game. We’ve finished about half of them. If you want more cinematic panel updates, you can check out Koni’s (Director/Artist) twitter [url=https://twitter.com/KoniWorx]here[/url] .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/cd7c7e8bfc555e17ace882efbba857800b080c6c.png[/img]

[b]Icy Mountain Nemesis![/b]
The nemesis in the Icy Mountain is actually a mammoth that was encapsulated in the ice! It awoke from it’s icy sleep when the aliens started rigging the caves with dynamite. Of course, we don’t want to hurt such an amazing creature.. So in this boss fight, you have to dodge it and tire it out!

[i]We call him Stumpy[/i] 🐘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/abee264f7eafbc34a560b5a98d17266fad520fca.gif[/img]

[b]Lightning Powerup![/b]
Powerups are always fun to add to Chenso Club! Here you can see the lightning power up at full energy, zapping adjacent foes! Stacking this powerup will increase its reach and probability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/7350c50c8f4ae2ecd5ed9a6a2f4f7ed5d4e8e2a7.gif[/img]


Here’s a list of highlights since last post:
[list]
[*] Final boss 100% implemented
[*] Final in-game cutscene 100% implemented
[*] Achievements
[*] Difficulty settings
[*] Race to the Treasure event
[*] Death screen that shows your runs statistic (kills, etc)
[*] All cinematics in text
[*] Many new powerups
[*] Resolution settings, etc
[*] A crapton of bug fixing
[/list]

notes.title: Chenso Club Devlog #9 - A juicy bit of content!
notes.content:
[b]Zoo wee mama[/b], it’s ya boiz from Pixadome!

Here’s a juicy bit of content - a new quest!
You’ll be running into this little dude named Mr.Time. When you meet him, you’ll be forced to make a choice. Will you accept his quest? Or will you suffer the consequence of denying it?

Mr.Time is an alien from the time dimension. He tells you that your time to die is now. But if you finish his challenge, he’ll reward you with more time to live and a powerful item. A timer will start above your head and it will tick down and when it reaches 0, you’ll die. Killing enemies will add seconds to the timer.

If you decline this challenge, the room will be packed with enemies and you’ll have to fight for your life.

What is your choice?

notes.title: Chenso Club Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/61bcce03a5f1a5f59c1cd54395c848dc26260423.gif[/img]

We are back from our vacation! We are feeling rested and ready to take on the Chenso Club once more!

As for any first week - it's been very much about getting the ball rolling again. But, that doesn't mean some exciting stuff hasn't been happening. Our current focus is to get an exciting game loop for unlocking content in the game, and fine polishing the content generation within the stages.

Jonas has been polishing up the stage generator, so that you won't be getting the same events and quests right after each other. He's also started work on the Chenso HQ, which will act as a hub in between runs. This is where you'll be unlocking stuff among other things!

Emil has been hard at work on fixing bugs, like animations not playing correctly on Carmine, dashing bugs, adding missing stuff like sounds on a few bosses, etc. The most exciting thing he’s added is the Janitor event (see gifs)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/48eeb93d38aed0a30ea46fbbc04e8a3026c4b83d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39207794/74f4051a85db4b010b9a3258a63f94fbd2c4a58b.gif[/img]

As for the art department, Koni and Max have been working on getting the ball rolling on a story within the game, which will come in the form of comics (more on this later!). We are also hard at work on animating enemies for the fourth stage!

WHAT WE'VE DONE THIS WEEK:
- Quests and events will now generate more evenly
- Hub Chenso HQ progress
- Fixed animations issue bugs
- Janitor NPC event
- Started work on cinematic comic style story
- "4th stage" enemy animations (half way done)

IN OTHER NEWS:
We've started discussing a different release plan of the game now, we cannot share much about this just yet. What we can tell you, however, is that this means you'll be getting to see way more content being posted, that we've held back. Both here and on social media. We hope you're looking forward to this!
